steps.label: 9.6 beforeAll does not mean exactly once globally
steps.narration: A Playwright Test worker may be restarted following a failed test.

steps.label: 9.7 Hooks vs fixtures
steps.narration: Interview-ready answer: I prefer fixtures for dependency management because they compose, support scopes and encapsulate setup and cleanup. Hooks are useful for common lifecycle behavior, but excessive hooks can hide test dependencies and reduce maintainability.
